script.title: Why spacecraft go to die at Point Nemo
sentences: There is a spot in the Pacific Ocean so remote, the nearest humans are often in space.
It is called Point Nemo, about 2,700 kilometres from the closest land.
When the International Space Station passes overhead, its crew is closer than anyone on Earth.
That loneliness makes it perfect for one job: a graveyard for spacecraft.
Since 1971, hundreds of old satellites and cargo ships have been steered down here.
The Russian space station Mir broke apart and sank in this region in 2001.
One day, the International Space Station itself is planned to fall here too.
Would you sail out to the loneliest place on the planet?
